groups.g: The twenty numbers that fit any answer

items.d: **$4.19 trillion, 4th largest**; 3rd by PPP; growth **6.5%**; contributes ~16% of global growth.
**₹2.35 lakh (~$2,880)**; lower-middle-income; Viksit Bharat 2047 implies ~$14,000 — a five-fold rise.
**4.4% of GDP (FY26 BE)**; capex **₹11.21 lakh crore (3.1% of GDP)**; capex multiplier 2.45 vs 0.98 for revenue spending.
Centre's gross tax-GDP **11.7%**; GST collections **₹22.08 lakh crore (FY25)**; GST slabs collapsed to **5% and 18% plus a 40% demerit rate** in 2025.
Total exports **$824.9 bn**; merchandise deficit ~$283 bn; **CAD 0.6% of GDP**; forex **~$690 bn**; remittances **$129.4 bn, the world's largest**.
**LFPR 60.1%, WPR 58.2%, UR 3.2%**; **FLFPR 23.3% (2017-18) → 41.7% (2023-24)**; agriculture's employment share rose to **46.1%**; ~90% informal.
**MPI 24.85% → 14.96%**, 24.82 crore out; extreme poverty **27.1% → 5.3%**, 171 million lifted; top 1% hold **40.1% of wealth**.
**1.46 billion**, most populous; **TFR 1.9, below replacement**; median age 28-29; 60-plus **10.5% → 20.8% by 2050**; urban **31.1% → ~40% by 2030**.
Public health spending **1.84% of GDP** (target 2.5%); **OOPE 62.6% → 39.4%**; MMR **97**; IMR 28; anaemia **57% women, 67% children**.
Spending **~4.6% of GDP** against the 6% Kothari/NEP target; only **23.4% of Class 3 children read a Class 2 text**; higher-education **GER 28.4%** against NEP's 50% by 2035.

Foodgrain **~354 MT**; horticulture **~355 MT, now larger**; net sown **140 mn ha**; **86% holdings small and marginal**, average **1.08 ha**; only **~6% of farmers sell at MSP**; **~10% of food is processed**.
Per capita **1,486 m³ (2021) → 1,367 by 2031**; India has **18% of world population and 4% of freshwater**; agriculture uses **78-80%**; groundwater supplies **60% of irrigation**.

**484 GW installed; non-fossil crossed 50% in June 2025, five years early**; coal is 48% of capacity but **~72% of generation**; per capita electricity **1,395 kWh** vs the world's 3,500; crude import dependence **88%**.
**3rd largest emitter (~7-8%)** but per capita **~2 tCO₂e vs 4.7 world**; NDC: **45% intensity cut by 2030, net zero 2070**; forest and tree cover **25.17%** against the 33% target.

**97 crore internet users**; **UPI 18-19 bn transactions a month, ~half of global real-time payments**; Aadhaar 142 crore; Jan Dhan 55 crore; DBT savings **₹3.48 lakh crore**; digital economy **11.74% of GVA**.
**5.29 crore cases pending**; **21 judges per million** against the recommended 50; **undertrials 75.8%** of prisoners; prison occupancy **131%**.
**2.55 lakh gram panchayats, ~31 lakh elected representatives, 46% women**; panchayats raise **~1%** of their own revenue; municipal own revenue **0.15% of GDP**.
Budget **₹6.81 lakh crore**; production **₹1.51 lakh crore**; exports **₹23,622 crore, up 34x since 2013-14**; LWE districts **126 (2010) → 38 (2024)**.
R&D **~0.64% of GDP** vs China's 2.4%; **3rd largest scientific publisher**; **GII rank 39, up from 81 in 2015**; space economy **$8.4 bn → $44 bn by 2033**.
MSMEs: **30% of GDP, 45% of exports, 23 crore jobs, 6+ crore units**; **1.6 lakh recognised startups, 100+ unicorns, 3rd largest ecosystem**, ~45% from tier-2/3 cities.
